newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up slightly on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up slightly on foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to advance marginally on Thursday on sustained foreign buying of discounted stocks, brokers said.
"The buying mood still in the market but there may be some profit taking late in the day after sharp gains yesterday," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.

Net foreign buying amounted to more than 600 million baht on Wednesday when the SET index finished 21.52 points higher at 635.71 on 6.4 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index rose 2.21 points to 47.93.
